SearchHow we decideRulings

Macrons

Consonantal i

Theme

House layout, roofs, rooms & furnishings

build up verb

a structure

also raise, raise the roof

classical

extollō, extollere

verb, third conjugation

raise, build up

Ancient verb; Lewis & Short gives it no classical perfect, and extulī is the perfect of efferō. This entry does not supply a speculative full set of principal parts.

Examples

  • Parietēs altius exstrūximus et novum tēctum imposuimus.

    We built the walls up higher and put on the new roof.composed

Other words

  • exstruō, exstruere, exstrūxī, exstrūctum — build up, raise (a structure)

    verb, third conjugation · also used · classical

    Use it for a past-tense “we raised the walls.”

See also build, erect, knee wall, roof.

SourcesLewis & Short: extollo · Lewis & Short: exstruo · Lewis & Short: effero

The example sentence marked “composed” is ours.
